manifest.eligibility_policy: Terminal original baseline with a source-bound pad_translation plan, complete plan.h5, unchanged source scene and existing motion; baseline task success is not an eligibility condition. Preserve every ineligible source in the unconditional denominator.
manifest.label: additional-box-policy-v1
manifest.policy: One frozen prior recipe on all28 previously unexecuted source episodes: contact005_velocity, arm speed retiming cap0.7rad/s, servo margin0.03rad, global-contact-4ms atdt0.001s. No new grasp geometry, object modifications, phase changes, success-conditioned selection or independent-demo count inflation.
